    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    bike_patches = image_patch.find("bicycle")
    
    if not man_patches or not bike_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_x = sum(p.horizontal_center for p in man_patches) / len(man_patches)
    bike_x = sum(p.horizontal_center for p in bike_patches) / len(bike_patches)
    
    riding_man = [m for m in man_patches if abs(m.horizontal_center - bike_x) < 20]
    
    if not riding_man:
        return image_patch
    
    return riding_man[0]
